row.title: gh issue search read a title prefix as a qualifier
row.body: org_profile_probe.sh found its issue with --search 'org-profile-probe: ... in:title'; the leading org-profile-probe: is parsed as a search qualifier, so a passing probe never closed issue 2107 and failing runs could file duplicates. It now matches the exact title over the open list.

title: gh issue search read a title prefix as a qualifier
